headline: Receptionist and Admin Clerk
summary: Receptionist and admin clerk with three years at a busy medical and dental clinic. I welcome patients, answer phones, book appointments and calm unhappy callers, while handling the clerical side of the office. I enjoy people-facing work and keep the front desk running smoothly.

experience.title: Receptionist and Admin Clerk
experience.employer: Biliran Family Medical and Dental Clinic
bullets: Greet about 80 patients a day, register them and direct them to the right doctor or dentist.
Answer the clinic phone line and book, confirm and move appointments for four practitioners.
Handle complaints about waiting times calmly and pass recurring issues to the clinic manager.
Prepare receipts, photocopies and simple letters for patients' insurance and school requirements.

experience.title: Sales and Customer Service Assistant
bullets: Assisted walk-in customers and answered phone enquiries about prices and deliveries.
Logged customer complaints about deliveries and followed them up with the warehouse.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
